spans.s:
1. Rebha in the Rigveda denotes a ‘singer’ of praise, a ‘panegyrist.’
Foot notes i. 127, 10; vi. 3, 6; 11, 3; vii. 63, 3; viii. 97, 11; ix. 7, 6, etc. Cf. Av. xx. 127, 4.

2. Rebha occurs in the Rigveda as the name of a protégé of the Aśvins, who saved him from the waters and from imprisonment.
Foot notes i. 112, 5; 116, 24; 117, 4; 118, 6; 119, 6; x. 39, 9.
